snippet.title: Your First Hours in Zarethia | Level 12 Knight vs Broodmother | Pixel Art MMORPG
snippet.description:
A brand-new knight's first steps in Zarethia, a free pixel-art MMORPG for Android and PC.

0:00 Forestedge, the first town: rats and wolves
Whispering Woods: Giant Worms and Forest Spiders
Floor −1, Root Burrows: Forest Spiders and Root Moles
Boss: Broodmother, the first boss you'll meet

Every land has floors above and below, and every boss drops a gemstone for the top damage dealer. Play free on Android and PC: https://zarethia.com

#Zarethia #MMORPG #PixelArt #IndieGame
